_documentation.purpose: Canonical solo-maintainer ruleset for luckyrjain/software-builder main.
_documentation.advisory_checks: install-macos and install-engine-windows run on every PR but are deliberately NOT required: they depend on macOS/Windows hosted runners, and with strict_required_status_checks_policy a runner outage or a flaky platform test would block every merge. Failures there are still visible on the PR; promote one to required by adding its job id to required_status_checks here and applying the ruleset.
solo_maintainer_notes: Do not require PR approvals — authors cannot self-approve.
Do not require CODEOWNER review until a second reviewer exists.
Keep the required status checks (lint-static, lint-suites) so CI protects main without human review.
_documentation.apply_via: Settings → Rules → Rulesets → main, or gh api PUT (repo admin token).
_documentation.verify_via: make verify-github-ruleset (requires gh auth with repo read access)
